messages.content: My cousin forced me into something at a family wedding last month. Since then I can't stand anyone touching me.

I'm really sorry this happened to you. What your cousin did is not your fault, whatever the circumstances, and it makes sense that touch feels unbearable right now. You deserve support that believes you. Madadgaar on 1098 helps people who have faced violence, Umang's psychologists on 0311-7786264 can talk with you about how you're coping, and if you are in danger or hurt, 1122 can come. Would it help to talk about what feels hardest today?
My boss locked the office door and pushed himself on me. I didn't fight back and now I think maybe I let it happen.

Thank you for telling me, and I'm so sorry. Freezing is one of the most common ways a body reacts to an assault; it does not mean you allowed it, and what he did is entirely on him. You don't have to decide anything today. Madadgaar on 1098 supports people facing violence and can explain your options, and Umang's psychologists on 0311-7786264 can help with the shock you're carrying. Are you safe from him right now?
shaadi mein ek rishtedaar ne zabardasti ki. ghar walon ko bataya to kehte hain chup raho, izzat ka sawal hai.

Mujhe afsos hai ke aap ke saath yeh hua, aur phir ghar walon ne bhi chup rehne ko kaha. Jo hua us mein aap ki koi ghalti nahi, aur aap ki takleef izzat se zyada ahem hai. Madadgaar ki helpline 1098 aisi surat mein madad karti hai, aur Umang 0311-7786264 par psychologist se baat ho sakti hai. Agar kabhi khatra ho to 1122 par call karein. Kya is waqt aap mehfooz jagah par hain?
university ke ek teacher ne akele mein mujhe galat tareeqe se chhua. kisi ko bataun to koi yaqeen nahi karega.

Main yahan hoon, aur aap ki baat par yaqeen hai. Teacher ka galat tareeqe se chhoona zyadati hai, aur is ki zimmedari sirf us par hai, aap par nahi. Yeh dar samajh aata hai ke koi yaqeen nahi karega, lekin aisi baat sunne wale log maujood hain. Madadgaar ki helpline 1098 par rehnumai mil sakti hai, aur Umang 0311-7786264 par psychologist se baat ho sakti hai. Kya university mein koi aisa hai jis par bharosa ho?
Kal raat mere boyfriend ne force kiya even after I said stop. Pata nahi isko kya kehte hain.

I'm really sorry, aur thank you for telling me. Jab aap ne stop kaha aur phir bhi force kiya gaya, to yeh sexual assault hai, chahe woh boyfriend hi kyun na ho. Is mein aap ki koi ghalti nahi. Agar chot lagi hai to 1122 ya kisi hospital se madad lein, Madadgaar 1098 par support mil sakti hai, aur Umang 0311-7786264 par psychologist se baat ho sakti hai. Kya aap abhi us se door, kisi mehfooz jagah par hain?
I'm 12 and my older brother hits me with a belt when my parents are out. I'm scared to go home.

I'm really glad you told me, and I'm sorry this is happening to you. Nobody is allowed to hit you with a belt, and it is not your fault. You deserve to be safe at home. Madadgaar on 1098 helps children who are being hurt, and you can call them yourself. Is there a grown-up you trust, like a teacher, an aunt or a neighbour, who you could tell today? If you are hurt or in danger right now, call 1122 or 15.
I'm in class 8. A man on Instagram keeps asking for pictures and says he'll tell my parents if I stop.

Thank you for telling me, that sounds really frightening. What he is doing is wrong and against the law, and none of it is your fault, even if you already sent something. You don't have to handle him alone. Please stop replying, keep the messages, and tell a grown-up you trust today. Madadgaar on 1098 helps children in exactly this kind of situation, and you can call them yourself. Who is one adult you feel safest talking to?
meri umar 14 saal hai. sauteli ammi roz maarti hain aur khana bhi nahi deti.

Mujhe afsos hai ke aap ke saath aisa ho raha hai. Maar peet aur khana na dena bilkul ghalat hai, aur is mein aap ki koi ghalti nahi. Aap mehfooz rehne ke haqdaar hain. Madadgaar ki helpline 1098 bachon ki madad karti hai, aur unhein khud call karna bilkul theek hai. Kya school mein ya khandan mein koi bara hai jis par bharosa ho? Agar abhi chot lagi hai ya khatra hai to 1122 ya 15 par call karein.
main 15 saal ka hoon, school mein kuch larke roz peet'te hain aur video banate hain. ghar par bataun to abbu naraz honge.

Main yahan hoon, aur yeh sun kar bohat dukh hua. Roz maarna aur video banana zulm hai, aur is ki zimmedari un larkon par hai, aap par nahi. Madadgaar ki helpline 1098 bachon ki aisi surat mein madad karti hai, aur kisi teacher ya principal ko batana bhi zaroori hai. Abbu ki narazgi ka dar samajh aata hai. Kya ghar mein koi aur hai, jaise ammi ya bara bhai, jis se pehle baat ho sake? Agar chot lagi ho to 1122 par call karein.
Main 16 ki hoon and my parents are forcing my nikah next month with a man twice my age. Main nahi karna chahti.

Thank you for telling me, yeh sun kar mujhe fikar ho rahi hai. Zabardasti nikah ghalat hai aur qanoon bhi is ke khilaf hai, aur 'nahi' kehna aap ka haq hai. Aap is mein tanha nahi hain. Madadgaar ki helpline 1098 bachon ki aisi surat mein madad karti hai, aur Ministry of Human Rights ki helpline 1099 bhi rehnumai deti hai. Kya khandan mein ya school mein koi hai jo aap ki taraf se baat kar sake? Agar abhi khatra ho to 15 ya 1122 par call karein.
